interview.name: Tess
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Tess is a reliable connector who relays needs and helps mobilize neighbors.
Quinn responds with appreciation and helps spread the word, showing active community coordination.
Eli is willing to contribute hands-on support, and the repair drive appears to be drawing strong participation.
Tess is coordinating a community repair drive and encouraging others to contribute specific help and supplies.
Eli, Sam, and Oren are each taking on concrete support roles, showing a cooperative group dynamic around a shared task.
Tess serves as the organizer and information relay, while others respond by donating labor, inventorying needs, or bringing missing items.
Tess is the central coordinator who keeps information flowing across the neighborhood.
Sam, Oren, Nell, and Leo are all contributing specific supplies or plans to the repair drive, suggesting a shared practical effort.
The group values timely updates and small acts of follow-through, with Tess acting as the main relay for needs and changes.
Tess is the main information broker and keeps several people updated about the repair drive.
Leo appears to be organizing the garage-side work and depends on Tess for progress updates.
Noah and Pia both want concise, reliable details, but Tess does not yet know the full logistics and is still checking.
Tess is the central coordinator for the repair drive and consistently relays updates to others.
Noah, Mara, and Ira are each providing support by asking for updates, sharing lists, or keeping an ear out.
The group is maintaining a collaborative, status-sharing workflow focused on what the repair drive still needs.

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—folks are really showing up with tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—thank you! I’m already telling a few neighbors to swing by, and I’ll keep passing along the word.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific. It’s nice to see everyone pitching in.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools all morning. If you’re heading over, they could probably use an extra set of hands.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I can stop by after lunch and help sort the tools.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Great, after lunch works perfectly. I’ll let them know you’re coming, and they’ll be glad for the help.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a list of what’s still missing. I’ll let you know if I spot anything we need to track down.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. Let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll keep an ear out for it.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Sam: Will do, Tess — I’ll check the donations and send you the missing items list. Thanks for keeping an ear out.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ve got the screws and duct tape, and I’m still trying to find a decent wrench too.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: Oh nice, that’s exactly the kind of stuff they’ll need. If you spot a wrench, bring it along — I’ll pass word if I hear they’re short on anything else.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring the screws and duct tape, and I’ll keep an eye out for that wrench too. If I hear of anything else they need, I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been great seeing everyone pitch in at the repair drive. I’ll keep listening for anything they still need and pass it along.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate you keeping an ear out. If you hear the time or any specific needs, please pass them along and I’ll help spread the word.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the time and any specific needs as soon as I hear them. It’s really nice seeing the whole neighborhood pull together.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — I’ll keep passing along any updates I hear, especially if they end up needing more tools or extra hands.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. Just send me any updates, and I’ll keep the garage plan moving.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they need anything else for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Oh, it’s going really well—folks have been bringing in tools and supplies all morning. I’ll keep listening and let you know if they still need anything else.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—do you know the exact drop-off time and where they’re collecting the repairs? I’d like to share the right details.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: I’m not sure of the exact drop-off time or spot yet, but I’ll ask around and pass it along as soon as I know.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still a little behind on the repair drive—can you give me the quick version?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Oh, it’s going well — folks have been showing up with tools and supplies, and they could still use extra hands. If you want, I’ll keep an ear out for anything else they need.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — that helps. If you hear what they still need, please let me know.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been going really well — folks are bringing in tools and supplies, and I’ll keep my ears open if they still need anything else.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Great — thanks, Tess. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything shifts and send the current assignments in a quick list.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll pass along the list and let you know if I hear they still need anything else.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been going really well — folks are still dropping off tools and supplies for the repair drive. If you hear of anything else they need, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and pass along anything I hear about what they still need.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Ira — I’ll keep listening too and let everyone know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Tess
